purpose: prospectively registered depth-displacement development sweep around two trained sources
role: development only; these events cannot serve as untouched confirmation
reference_role: old +/-240 m results, descriptive context only
fd: same 401x401x94 Overthrust grid at 40 m, 5 Hz, 0-2 s, dt=0.002 s, 25 receivers and six zero-Dirichlet faces
waveform_metrics: raw relative L2 on the full true-source receiver record and on FD active samples; finite waveform change from each training anchor (cosine, norm ratio and change-relative L2)
arrival_rule: per-trace first sample with three consecutive |trace| values >= 0.05 of that trace peak; FD station must have peak >= 0.01 of FD global peak and pick <= 1.85 s; compute signed bias and RMSE on paired model-FD picks, count model pick failures; same unshifted origin time
interpretation: descriptive paired source-depth development, one seed, two training anchors and one velocity; compare model and FD waveforms without optimizing source, time, gain or search; no independent localization or generalization claim
